title: 第9章  鸡蛋补身子
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦淮茹急着往娘家赶。

李阳也不磨蹭，拿推拿的法子替她把崴伤的脚脖子拾掇了一番。

手上的劲道刚柔相济，揉捏了没多大功夫，效果就显出来了。秦淮茹嘴上还说有点疼，可脚已经能沾地走道了。

“甭走远喽。”李阳叮嘱了一句。

“明儿个你要回城，我骑车送你到公路边上去搭班车，别硬撑着走。”

秦淮茹点点头应道：“行，多亏有你在，要不我真抓瞎了。”

李阳笑了笑，搀着秦淮茹出了屋门，走到房檐底下。

“先别急着走。我灶房里头还剩十来个窝头，咱俩热了对付一顿，你再去秦家村也不晚。”李阳跟她商量。

秦淮茹抬头瞅了瞅天。冬天天短，这光景已经擦黑了。

李阳见她犹豫，又补了一句：

“你甭指望回了娘家能落着一口好吃的，怕是连顿热乎饭都蹭不上。”

“眼下谁家都缺这一口，听我一句劝，吃了再过去。我是为你想。”

秦淮茹听了，点了点头：“也罢，那就吃了再走。”

娘家眼下是个啥光景，她虽好些年没登过门，可心里头大概也能描出来。

李阳笑着扶她进了灶房。

灶房里黑咕隆咚的，李阳划了根洋火把煤油灯点上，又把灶坑里的火引着了。

“昨儿个我收了几个鸡子，你想不想尝尝？”李阳偏过头问她。

秦淮茹嗓子眼里咕咚咽了下口水，瞪圆了眼说：“你们跑采购的就是门路宽。有得吃我可不跟你假客气了，我是真有些年头没沾过鸡子的味儿了。”

李阳笑了笑没言语。先把水坐上，等锅里冒了热汽就能腾窝头了。

灶上安排妥当，他又起身去堂屋。

照老规矩摸了四个鸡子过来，磕进碗里，等会儿一块煎了。

“当真是鸡子！”秦淮茹伸长脖子瞅了瞅，又惊又喜。

李阳乐了：“那还能有假？我还能拿假的糊弄你不成？”

秦淮茹眼睛里亮晶晶的，脸上绽开了笑，又高兴又新鲜。

说起来，打她嫁进贾家的门，就没正儿八经吃过一口好的。

家里但凡有点荤腥，得先尽着贾东旭和贾张氏。

后来添了儿子棒梗，但凡有点好的更轮不上她了。

至于小当，因是个丫头片子，贾张氏和贾东旭正眼都不带瞧的。

秦淮茹不光没落下好，反倒平白惹他们嫌恶。

说她肚皮不争气，就更甭惦记吃好的了。

Page (1/3)

Qin Huairu rushed to her parents' house in a hurry.

Li Yang didn't waste any time and used massage to tidy up her injured ankle.

The strength of the hands is a combination of hardness and softness, and the effect is evident within a short time of kneading.Qin Huairu said it hurt a little, but her feet could already touch the ground and walk.

"Don't go too far." Li Yang warned.

"You have to go back to the city tomorrow. I'll take you to the side of the road on my bike to catch the shuttle bus. Don't force yourself to walk."

Qin Huairu nodded and said, "Okay, thank you for being here, otherwise I would have been blinded."

Li Yang smiled and helped Qin Huairu out of the house and walked under the eaves.

"Don't leave in a hurry yet. There are still about ten steamed buns left in my kitchen. Let's deal with them after we heat them up. It won't be too late for you to go to Qinjia Village." Li Yang discussed with her.

Qin Huairu raised his head and glanced at the sky.Winter is short and the scene has become dark.

Seeing her hesitation, Li Yang added:

"Don't expect to get a delicious bite when you return to your parents' home. I'm afraid you won't even be able to get a hot meal."

"Everyone is in need of this right now. Listen to my advice and eat before going over. I'm thinking about you."

Qin Huairu listened and nodded: "That's fine, just eat before leaving."

What was the current situation of her parents' family? Even though she hadn't visited the house in several years, she could probably describe it in her mind.

Li Yang smiled and helped her into the kitchen.

The kitchen was dark, so Li Yang lit a match and lit the kerosene lamp, then lit the fire in the stove.

"I collected some chickens yesterday, do you want to try them?" Li Yang turned his head and asked her.

Qin Huairu swallowed hard, her eyes widened and she said, "You are the ones who go shopping because you have a wide network. If you have something to eat, I won't be polite to you. I really haven't tasted chicken for some years."

Li Yang smiled and said nothing.Put the water on it first, and wait until the steam comes out of the pot to make the steamed buns.

After the arrangements were made on the stove, he got up and went to the main room again.

Following the old rules, I brought four chickens over, smashed them into a bowl, and fried them together later.

"It's really a chicken!" Qin Huairu stretched her neck and took a look, surprised and delighted.

Li Yang was delighted: "How can it be fake? Can I fool you with a fake one?"

Qin Huairu's eyes were sparkling, and a smile broke out on her face, happy and fresh.

Speaking of which, she had never had a good meal since she married into the Jia family.

Whenever there is something fishy in the house, Jia Dongxu and Jia Zhang must be treated first.

Later, she got a son who was a good guy, but it was not her turn to be a good guy.

As for Xiaodang, because it was a girl's film, Jia Zhang and Jia Dongxu didn't take it seriously.

Qin Huairu not only failed to survive, but also made them hate her for nothing.

Saying that her belly is not up to par, let alone worrying about eating well.
